subject: row-pair-lean/PhysicalTripleSmall.lean
scope: Exact row-pair defect is used to bound the full complementary tail l1 norm; 31/8 is strictly above sqrt15.
Both half-row sums are derived from actual Physical H orthogonality, with i distinct from rows0and1 and literal Dephased H.
Left phase lift uses H i0=1 and actual unit H i1,H i2. No phase-existence premise is assumed.
Right phase lift divides by the actual fourth entry via its conjugate; the unit norm follows from Physical H, and the lift is multiplied back to the original H i4,H i5.
hypotheses: Physical H, Dephased H, i≠0, i≠1, squared seed-entry defect≤5δ² and l1 seed-entry defect≤3δ. These are exactly the two row-pair bounds supplied by the paired phase hypothesis.
limitations: No orientation pairing, family matching, witness bound, or Fourier tube theorem is asserted by this file. Review admits the four displayed supporting statements only; no box closure.
